races.name: Wexfordraces.ie Beginners Chase

runners_data.name: Karoline Banbou
runners_data.note: Prominent racer with strong form on good/soft ground, Harry Cobden booking suggests confidence despite 65 days off
runners_data.comment: Second on both completed starts over fences, bids to make amends now for Leopardstown fall
runners_data.spotlight: 130-rated hurdler; fair efforts on first two chase runs, though was beaten by longer-priced stablemate Port Joulain at Fairyhouse in January; beaten falling at the last in a Leopardstown event that has been well advertised by the 8l runner-up Come Walk With Me in landing handicaps at Fairyhouse and Punchestown.

runners_data.name: Farfromnowhere
runners_data.note: Only confirmed front-runner who should get uncontested lead, proven stamina suggests he can sustain strong pace
runners_data.comment: Decent hurdler over longer trips, solid chase form, 2m looks a bit short but could prevail
runners_data.spotlight: Useful hurdler whose two wins were gained over longer trips than this; ran only twice over fences last season; promising effort behind Kala Conti over 2m5f at Cork, well beaten in fourth in a Limerick Grade 3 contest over 2m6f; in rear in the Martin Pipe at Cheltenham; 2m looks a bit short but could prevail.

runners_data.name: Mercury Mission
runners_data.note: Hold-up type who needs strong pace to be effective, 7lb claiming jockey may struggle tactically in large field
runners_data.comment: Fine effort when second at 80-1 at Clonmel, this looks like a more competitive race
runners_data.spotlight: Three-time hurdles winner (rated 113); unseated early on stable and chase debut at Downpatrick; ran a fine race from the front  at 80-1 when second to the useful Royal Hollow at Clonmel last month; should be able to pick up a race over fences on that evidence but this looks like a more competitive race.

runners_data.name: Kilgame
runners_data.note: Henry De Bromhead runner returning after 47 days, prominent style suits likely tactical pace but stamina questions remain
runners_data.comment: Got his career back on track when winning a 23-runner maiden hurdle at Navan in March
runners_data.spotlight: Second over hurdles at Auteuil in March 2024; ran only twice last season; shaped well at Leopardstown last December on reappearance; appeared not to stay the near-2m3f trip at Naas in January; got his career back on track when winning a 23-runner maiden hurdle at Navan in March.

runners_data.name: Mister Pink
runners_data.note: Prominent type for in-form Ross O'Sullivan stable, recent chasing debut suggests improvement to come
runners_data.comment: Won a bumper and a 2m4f maiden hurdle for Willie Mullins, well beaten on stable debut
runners_data.spotlight: Won a bumper and a 2m4f maiden hurdle for Willie Mullins; after a long absence, beaten from three out on stable/chasing debut in a Cork race won by Mullins with subsequent Punchestown handicap winner Funiculi Funicula.

runners_data.name: Faulty
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning after coughing issues, 60 days off may leave him short of peak fitness
runners_data.comment: Won over hurdles in 2024, jumped untidily and never in contention at Naas on chasing debut
runners_data.spotlight: Winner of a Down Royal maiden hurdle in March 2024; reported coughing after a poor run the following month; off for almost two years before chasing debut at Naas two months ago, jumped untidily and never in contention.

runners_data.name: Mick Collins
runners_data.note: Long absence of 222 days is major concern despite previous hurdle form showing ability
runners_data.comment: Winning hurdler, Flat win over 1m4f came after a lengthy break so could go well here
runners_data.spotlight: Won 4yo maiden hurdle at Punchestown last June on good ground; placed in novice events at Bellewstown and Galway; failed to sustain that form in two outings before being left off in the autumn; Flat win over 1m4f came after a lengthy break, so could go well here.

runners_data.name: Did I Ask You That
runners_data.note: Paul Townend booking suggests stable confidence despite 102 days off and patchy recent form
runners_data.comment: Reported blowing hard after his two most recent outings, seems very risky
runners_data.spotlight: Second in a bumper in 2022; third to The Big Westerner in a 2m6f Punchestown maiden hurdle in November 2024; off for a year; slipped up before three out when travelling well in the same maiden last season; reported blowing hard after a tame run at Tramore; same excuse offered at Naas; seems very risky.

runners_data.name: Glenashling
runners_data.note: Solid chasing form last season, prominent style suits but may lack the class edge in this company
runners_data.comment: Second in a six-runner handicap at Cork, officially rated 11lb inferior to Karoline Banbou
runners_data.spotlight: Maiden hurdle winner early last year; fair form over fences last season, best effort a second placing at Punchestown in November when in front of the useful Coral River; runner-up in a six-runner contest at Cork on handicap debut; officially rated 11lb inferior to Karoline Banbou.

runners_data.name: Wild Bill Hickok
runners_data.note: Hold-up type with 7lb claimer, needs strong pace and tactical ride to overcome poor recent French form
runners_data.comment: Lost form over hurdles in France, best watched on his first attempt over fences
runners_data.spotlight: Won a Listed Hurdle for 3yos at Auteuil in April last year; badly out of sorts in France subsequently; a bit better on debut for Ciaran Murphy in a handicap hurdle at Aintree; best watched on first attempt over fences.

runners_data.name: Jerrari
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner who won twice on good ground last summer, testing conditions previously went against him
runners_data.comment: Won twice over hurdles, could make a summer chaser, will probably need to gain experience
runners_data.spotlight: Back-to-back winner of handicap hurdle at Roscommon and Galway last summer, both at around 2m on good ground; testing conditions were against him at Navan in February; harder to excuse a poor Downpatrick run; unplaced at Kilbeggan last time; could make a summer chaser but will probably need to gain experience.

runners_data.name: Fenian Maxios
runners_data.note: Hold-up type with 7lb claimer whose improved Thurles second looks like a one-off performance
runners_data.comment: His much-improved second at Thurles in March seems to have been a flash in the pan
runners_data.spotlight: Has run five times over hurdles; his much-improved second at Thurles in March seems to have been a flash in the pan, since he has struggled in two subsequent outings.

races.paceDynamic: Farfromnowhere is the only confirmed front-runner in this field and should get an uncontested lead, setting a manageable gallop over this 2m trip. The bulk of the field - including Karoline Banbou, Kilgame, Mister Pink, and Glenashling - are prominent racers who will track close behind, while hold-up horses Mercury Mission, Wild Bill Hickok, Jerrari, and Fenian Maxios will need to come from off the pace. With no early pace pressure on Farfromnowhere and a large group of prominent types clustered behind, the race should develop into a tactical affair with a sprint finish from the last fence. This setup clearly favours the prominent racers who can position handily and have the tactical speed to strike when the race comes alive, rather than hold-up horses who may struggle to pick up the pieces if the pace is modest.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Brigade Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent racers can track Farfromnowhere at a comfortable gallop and produce their kicks from ideal positions
scenarios.body: The tactical pace will suit horses like Karoline Banbou and Kilgame who can sit handy and quicken when the race develops. The hold-up horses will find themselves too far back when the sprint begins from the last fence.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Farfromnowhere Goes Clear
scenarios.trigger: If Farfromnowhere uses his front-running ability to steal a march and the chasers react too late
scenarios.body: His stamina over longer trips suggests he can maintain a strong gallop, and if the prominent horses hesitate or get in each other's way, he could build an unassailable lead. The later kick merchants will have too much ground to make up.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Hero Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes truly crawling and it turns into a dash from the home turn
scenarios.body: Mercury Mission or Jerrari could benefit from a truly-run finish where their finishing kick becomes the decisive weapon. However, they need the race to completely fall apart tactically to overcome their positioning disadvantage.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Mullins One-Two Materializes
scenarios.trigger: If both Karoline Banbou and Did I Ask You That are primed for big runs despite their recent form
scenarios.body: The stable's double-handed approach could see them work together tactically, with Harry Cobden and Paul Townend positioning perfectly. This requires both horses to be significantly better than their recent efforts suggest.

watchPoints.text: Mercury Mission could surprise at big odds if the pace collapses completely, but his 5lb claiming jockey may struggle with positioning
Watch Farfromnowhere's jumping early - if fluent he could build unassailable lead given lack of pace pressure
Karoline Banbou and Did I Ask You That both represent Willie Mullins despite poor recent form - market support would be telling
Wild Bill Hickok's Listed hurdle win in France shows ability exists, but his 7lb claimer faces major tactical test
Track Kilgame's stamina over this 2m trip - shaped like he needs further when last seen at Leopardstown

races.name: Visitwexford.ie Handicap Chase

runners_data.name: Half A Chance
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist returning from 32 days off for in-form jockey Alan O'Sullivan, needs strong pace to be effective
runners_data.comment: Straight into handicap company for chase debut and inexperience a concern
runners_data.spotlight: Sole win came in 2m Limerick maiden hurdle two years ago; consistent placed form in handicap hurdles last year, well below best last month at Plumpton; straight into handicap company for chase debut and inexperience a concern.

runners_data.name: Presenting Lad
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse back from 189-day layoff on much-reduced mark, has winning form at this level when fresh
runners_data.comment: Veteran returns from 7 months' absence off much-reduced mark
runners_data.spotlight: Chase wins came at Roscommon and Tramore in 2024; well held in handicaps last year and returns from 7 months' absence off much-reduced mark.

runners_data.name: Tequila Talkin'
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner who struggled on softer surfaces recently, should improve back on better ground conditions
runners_data.comment: Well-backed on last month's chase debut here when fourth over 2m4f; drops in trip
runners_data.spotlight: Maiden hurdle win came here (2m4f, good) last summer; softer ground in recent outings wouldn't have been ideal so potential improver now back on better ground, having not quite got home when fourth in 2m4f novice handicap on chase debut here last month (well-backed); drops in trip.

runners_data.name: Soldante
runners_data.note: Natural prominent runner who will lead uncontested, recent third at Tramore gives him fitness edge over rivals
runners_data.comment: Recent Tramore third was encouraging on only second chase start; one to consider
runners_data.spotlight: Tramore maiden hurdle winner in late 2023 and best of two recent runs over fences came at same venue last month when rallying third (In The Trenches fifth) in 2m novice handicap chase; could be capable of better over fences so one to consider.

runners_data.name: Pahlavi
runners_data.note: Prominent tracker returning from 201-day break, won last time at Downpatrick in similar conditions
runners_data.comment: Absent since October and opposable on second chase start
runners_data.spotlight: Breakthrough success over hurdles came at Downpatrick last summer (2m2f, good), absent since midfield in 2m Limerick handicap in October, having had an easy lead; only second chase start (well held in Roscommon handicap last summer).

runners_data.name: Shannon Bank
runners_data.note: Can race prominently, career-best effort came from off strong pace at Killarney, needs genuine gallop
runners_data.comment: Ex Gavin Cromwell; absent since October and debuts over fences for new yard
runners_data.spotlight: Maiden took her mark to a career-high when coming from well back to chase home a clear winner in 2m1f Killarney  handicap hurdle in October (yielding); never recovered from bad blunder at Sligo later same month in first-time cheekpieces; has since left Gavin Cromwell and debuts for new yard on chase debut.

runners_data.name: In The Trenches
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with consistent placed form, fifth in similar contest 18 days ago gives him race fitness
runners_data.comment: Not beaten far at Tramore recently off this mark; contender on favoured ground
runners_data.spotlight: Long-standing maiden; has run well in defeat over fences and hurdles, including runner-up in 2m2f Cork handicap chase, most recently beaten under 2l when fifth of 8 in steadily-run 2m Tramore novice handicap chase last month;  ground to suit and definite contender.

runners_data.name: Midnight Moonshine
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner returning from fall 37 days ago, prefers longer trips but has winning form on good ground
runners_data.comment: Remains on a competitive mark but best form is over much further
runners_data.spotlight: Kilbeggan maiden hurdle winner last year is 0-9 chasing but some good placed efforts at around 3m, early last season; halfway faller on return to track in March and now takes a marked drop in trip.

runners_data.name: Butter Fingers
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer who switched back to hurdles after struggling over fences, placed at Naas last time
runners_data.comment: Scope for improvement off this 7lb lower chase mark
runners_data.spotlight: Flat/hurdle wins came in 2024; 0-4 chasing this past season (blood in nostrils fourth occasion) and back hurdling the last twice, notably when placed in 2m Naas handicap off 110; scope for improvement off this 7lb lower chase mark.

runners_data.name: Courtbrack Boy
runners_data.note: Prominent racer who won maiden hurdle in heavy ground, showed promise on chase debut last month
runners_data.comment: Chase debut second at Tramore very encouraging; 2lb rise okay, likely major player
runners_data.spotlight: Off the mark at the seventh attempt over hurdles at Clonmel (2m, heavy) in February; beaten off 7lb higher mark subsequently but good run on chase debut last month in 2m Tramore handicap, making most until outpointed from last by strong favourite (yielding); 2lb rise okay, likely major player.

runners_data.name: Ernie From Nurney
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse returning from 89-day break, best form came on much softer surfaces in 2024
runners_data.comment: Dual hurdles winner but just sporadic glimpses of form nowadays
runners_data.spotlight: Back-to-back handicap hurdle winner in April 2024 on soft-to-heavy; only glimpses of his best form since, placed in Thurles handicap chase early last year best run; pulled up over hurdles at Naas in February on latest.

runners_data.name: L'Amiral Fromentin
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner with fading finish concerns, showed improvement in recent third at Tramore
runners_data.comment: Recent Tramore third encouraging but bit to find with runner-up Courtbrack Boy
runners_data.spotlight: First real effort of note on latest when decent third (3l off runner-up Courtbrack Boy) in 2m Tramore novice handicap chase last month (yielding); 5yo seems to be on the upgrade.

runners_data.name: Let Him B
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with fading tendencies, progressive hurdler but question marks over his stamina reserves
runners_data.comment: Improving 6yo could make an immediate impact chasing although drop in trip not be ideal
runners_data.spotlight: Progressive handicap hurdler this past season, off the mark over 2m5f at Down Royal in March (yielding) and better again following month off 11lb higher when clear second to a ready winner over 2m4f at Limerick (soft-to-heavy); improving 6yo could make an immediate impact chasing here although drop in trip may not be ideal.

races.paceDynamic: Soldante is the only confirmed front runner and will be allowed to dictate a sustainable tempo from the start without early pressure. Pahlavi, Shannon Bank and Courtbrack Boy can track prominently but none are natural pace-pressers over this trip. The lack of genuine speed will create a tactical affair with the main body of hold-up horses including In The Trenches, Half A Chance, Presenting Lad and Midnight Moonshine needing to time their moves perfectly from off the pace. This moderate early gallop and compressed field approaching the final fences strongly favours hold-up horses with finishing speed who can capitalize on the tactical nature.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Tactical Hold-Up Battle
scenarios.trigger: If Soldante sets uncontested fractions and the field bunches turning for home
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where horses with natural finishing pace thrive over those who need strong gallops. Hold-up performers like In The Trenches and Half A Chance get ideal conditions to unleash their kicks.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracking Success
scenarios.trigger: If Pahlavi or Courtbrack Boy track Soldante closely and kick clear approaching the last
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace allows patient prominent runners to conserve energy before striking. These horses avoid the scrimmaging behind while staying close enough to pounce when it matters.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Soldante Wire-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If the front runner gets generous fractions and maintains momentum when challenged
scenarios.body: The uncontested leader builds an unassailable advantage that hold-up horses cannot reel in despite their finishing efforts. Soldante's stamina reserves prove decisive in the final 200 yards.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Late Closer Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the moderate pace completely falls apart and becomes a crawl to the second-last fence
scenarios.body: The race turns into an absolute sprint where a horse with untapped finishing speed can come from nowhere. Fading finish concerns become irrelevant in such a short dash home.

watchPoints.text: Soldante could steal this if allowed completely uncontested fractions with no pace pressure from the prominent runners
Half A Chance and In The Trenches need the pace to develop properly or they'll be left with too much ground to make up
Presenting Lad faces significant fitness questions after 189-day absence despite the attractive reduced handicap mark
Courtbrack Boy's chase debut form suggests he could handle the step up in class if tracking the pace successfully
Weather conditions could change the going description which would particularly impact horses returning from layoffs

races.name: Wexford Town Handicap Chase

runners_data.name: Captain Conby
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer returning from 877-day layoff faces fitness concerns despite useful 2023 form
runners_data.comment: Should be sharper now following a comeback on the Flat, had very useful form in 2023
runners_data.spotlight: Should be sharper now following a comeback on the Flat; had very useful form in 2023; might just need another race or two to become competitive again.

runners_data.name: Come On The Lads
runners_data.note: Strong hold-up type from Gavin Cromwell yard with recent Galway success, ideally suited to expected pace scenario
runners_data.comment: Returned from a break to win in good style at Limerick, leading chance despite 8lb rise
runners_data.spotlight: Useful hurdler won a valuable prize at Galway last year; ran well at Fairyhouse on the first of two chase starts last autumn; returned from a break to win in good style at Limerick; leading chance despite 8lb rise.

runners_data.name: Crowsatedappletart
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner with excellent Wexford course record, recent hurdles run should sharpen him for this chase return
runners_data.comment: Won twice at this venue last July, likely to show the benefit of a recent hurdles run
runners_data.spotlight: Seven-time winner over hurdles/fences; won twice at this venue last July; likely to show the benefit of a recent hurdles run at Limerick; noteworthy on account of his ability to handle the track; good chance with a top claimer aboard.

runners_data.name: An Peann Dearg
runners_data.note: Class hold-up performer dropping in grade after Leopardstown campaigns, sights lowered to good effect
runners_data.comment: Sights are lowered here after running in stronger company at Leopardstown in the winter
runners_data.spotlight: Both chase wins have been in 2m1f handicaps at Leopardstown; sights are lowered here after running in stronger company at that venue during the winter.

runners_data.name: Baltic Bird
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning from 194-day break, stamina questions at this minimum trip
runners_data.comment: Ground should be coming right for him now, probably needs further than this, no recent run
runners_data.spotlight: Ground should be coming right for him now; probably needs further than this, and his lack of a recent run is a possible drawback.

runners_data.name: Cappucino
runners_data.note: Prominent type with solid chase form, trainer tongue-tie suggests confidence after Tramore second
runners_data.comment: Had an excuse when pulled up at Thurles last time, definite chance if restored to his best
runners_data.spotlight: Won Listowel bumper and Punchestown maiden hurdle the season before last; best chase run yet when second at Tramore on New Year's Day; had an excuse when pulled up at Thurles last time; definite chance if restored to his best.

runners_data.name: Trasna Na Pairce
runners_data.note: Only confirmed front-runner will dictate terms unopposed, though previous wins came over longer trips
runners_data.comment: Hurdle wins at Clonmel last season were over further, the ground should be ideal for him
runners_data.spotlight: Back-to-back hurdling wins at Clonmel last summer; also front-running second at same venue in a 2m3f novice handicap chase; wins were over further; on the positive side, the ground should be ideal for him.

runners_data.name: War Correspondent
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse needing to rebound from pulled-up effort, proven Grade 3 class on his day
runners_data.comment: Not an easy horse to win with and has to rebound now after a failure at Tramore
runners_data.spotlight: Dual-purpose sort showed decent form over fences last autumn, including third in a Punchestown Grade 3 novice; not an easy horse to win with and has to rebound now after a failure over hurdles at Tramore.

runners_data.name: Dutch Schultz
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer from in-form Cromwell yard, dual-purpose type with Killarney chase success
runners_data.comment: Not a bad run at Fairyhouse after a break, Come On The Lads seems to be yard's number one
runners_data.spotlight: Dual-purpose type; most recent of two chase wins came in a 2m1f Killarney handicap chase in August 2024; best effort last year when fourth in a 24-runner handicap chase at the Punchestown festival; not a bad run at Fairyhouse after a break; however, Come On The Lads seems to be the yard's number one.

runners_data.name: Kilbrin Rocco
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner with recent Tramore win, lightest weight could be significant asset in sustained finish
runners_data.comment: Possibly value for more than the neck margin when winning at Tramore, only 4lb higher
runners_data.spotlight: Possibly value for more than the neck margin when winning at Tramore last month; only 4lb higher and is at the right end of the handicap here; every chance of getting in the mix.

races.paceDynamic: Trasna Na Pairce is the only confirmed front-runner in this field and will be allowed to dictate terms from the start, setting a manageable pace without early pressure. Baltic Bird and Cappucino may track in second and third early, but neither will challenge the leader aggressively in the opening stages. This creates a tactical race where the pace will likely be steady through the middle sections before quickening from the second-last fence. The sustained gallop and lack of early pace pressure clearly favours hold-up horses who can produce late kicks, particularly those with proven stamina at this trip.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the pace remains steady until the home turn as expected
scenarios.body: Trasna Na Pairce sets uncontested fractions allowing closers to wind up from the back, with the race becoming a sprint finish where class and finishing kick matter most. Hold-up performers with proven turn of foot will have every chance to unleash their challenge.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Steals It
scenarios.trigger: If Trasna Na Pairce gets away with very slow fractions and kicks clear
scenarios.body: The Henry De Bromhead runner exploits the lack of pace pressure to build an unassailable lead, with the field leaving their challenges too late on the testing ground. His front-running style proves perfectly suited when the pace collapses completely.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Trackers Strike
scenarios.trigger: If Baltic Bird or Cappucino apply earlier pressure to the leader
scenarios.body: The pace becomes more honest when prominent runners engage earlier, creating a stronger gallop that suits horses positioned handy who can quicken without needing to make up significant ground. This tactical shift benefits those racing in the first half of the field.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If no horse challenges Trasna Na Pairce at any stage until too late
scenarios.body: The race becomes a crawling affair where tactical positioning trumps class, allowing any horse to win regardless of ability if connections time their move perfectly. The finish becomes a lottery where the best-positioned horse on the day prevails.

watchPoints.text: Trasna Na Pairce gets uncontested lead - if no prominent runners engage early, he could steal the race with soft fractions
Come On The Lads positioning in rear - needs clear run and strong pace to unleash proven finishing kick from hold-up position
Baltic Bird travels smoothly despite 194-day break - fitness concerns may not matter if pace collapses as expected
Cappucino applies early pressure to leader - any tactical change from prominent position could alter entire race dynamic
An Peann Dearg gets competitive ride from Sean O'Keeffe - class horse whose chance depends entirely on strong pace developing

races.name: Purple And Gold Beginners Chase

runners_data.name: Hiddenvalley Lake
runners_data.note: Highest-rated but concerning recent form and 26 days off, prominent style suits the likely pace scenario
runners_data.comment: Let down by jumping on chase debut back in late 2023 but Grade 1-winning hurdler since
runners_data.spotlight: Classy hurdler rated (154) some way superior to these, career highlight when winning 3m Grade 1 Liverpool Hurdle at Aintree just over a year ago; only fifth when attempting repeat win there last month but looks a class apart from these rivals if anyway fluent in his jumping (wasn't that on sole previous chase start back in December 2023); interesting jockey booking.

runners_data.name: Long Branch
runners_data.note: Solid recent chase form and prominent style perfectly matches this race shape, only 8 days since last run
runners_data.comment: 118-rated hurdler needs to improve for switch to fences to feature in a major way
runners_data.spotlight: 118-rated hurdler won 2m7f Thurles novice last season (yielding) and chased home a clear winner in 3m novice here last month on similar ground; left with plenty to do in first-time cheekpieces last week when staying on into a remote fourth over inadequate 2m4f at the Punchestown festival; needs to improve for switch to fences to feature in a major way.

runners_data.name: D Art D Art
runners_data.note: Hold-up style faces tactical disadvantage with likely soft pace, 32 days since last run may need this
runners_data.comment: Well below best hurdling last season and now debuts over fences
runners_data.spotlight: 125-rated hurdler was in good form 2024/25 season, winning twice and running well in 3m Pertemps Final at Cheltenham; well below that level in light campaign last season however and now tries fences.

runners_data.name: American Jukebox
runners_data.note: Promising profile for Elliott but 81 days off represents significant layoff concern, wears pull-up bit
runners_data.comment: American Mike's half-brother rated 117 over hurdles; more likely needed on chase debut
runners_data.spotlight: Half-brother to 145-rated chaser American Mike; placed in 2m4f bumper and off the mark hurdling when making virtually all for runaway win in ordinary 2m6f Tramore maiden last season (soft); safely held twice afterwards in handicaps and returns from a break for chase debut.

runners_data.name: Eclipse Chaser
runners_data.note: Talented but too keen last time when pulled up, hold-up style doesn't suit likely race dynamics, wears tongue tie
runners_data.comment: Disappointed in handicap hurdles last term; could make a better chaser
runners_data.spotlight: 121-rated hurdler who won 2m5f Navan maiden early last season (yielding) but struggled in handicaps, too keen when pulled up at Fairyhouse last time; half-brother to Grade 2-winning chaser Westerner Lady so fair chance he'll take to chasing.

runners_data.name: One Big Boum
runners_data.note: Natural front runner with progressive hurdles form, gets ideal scenario as likely lone pace-setter
runners_data.comment: Progressive hurdler upped in trip for chase debut and could go well if taking to fences
runners_data.spotlight: Progressive handicap hurdler last season took his mark to 125 after wins over 2m4f at Navan and Fairyhouse (heavy); 2m trip inadequate here on final start in March; upped in trip for chase debut and could go well if taking to fences.

races.paceDynamic: One Big Boum appears the only confirmed front runner in this six-runner field, with Long Branch, American Jukebox and Hiddenvalley Lake all capable of racing prominently but none with automatic leading tendencies. Eclipse Chaser and D Art D Art will likely settle further back as hold-up performers. With just one natural leader, One Big Boum can dictate terms and set a comfortable pace without pressure, creating a race that builds steadily rather than developing into a sprint. This tactical setup strongly favours prominent racers who can track the leader and strike at the optimum moment.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Lead Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If One Big Boum gets an easy lead and isn't pressured early
scenarios.body: The front runner can dictate fractions and prove hard to peg back up the hill, especially given his progressive profile over this trip. Hold-up horses face too much to do from off the pace with the race run to suit the leader.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Long Branch or American Jukebox track One Big Boum closely and time their challenge
scenarios.body: The patient prominent runner can measure the leader's effort and strike when the pace lifts approaching the final fence. This allows them to benefit from the steady gallop while avoiding the front runner's workload.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Class Tells Late
scenarios.trigger: If Hiddenvalley Lake overcomes his sketchy recent form and produces his best
scenarios.body: The highest-rated runner could use superior ability to make ground from mid-division despite the race shape not ideally suiting. His 154 hurdles rating gives him a significant class edge if he can reproduce past form.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and becomes a sprint finish
scenarios.body: Eclipse Chaser or D Art D Art could benefit from a truly-run race that sets up perfectly for closers. However, this requires the unlikely scenario of genuine early pace pressure on One Big Boum.

watchPoints.text: One Big Boum must be monitored for how freely he travels in front - if laboring early the whole race dynamic changes
Eclipse Chaser showed keen tendencies when pulled up last time - watch if he settles better with the tongue tie
American Jukebox making chase debut after 81-day break - observe if ring rustiness affects his jumping fluency
Long Branch carries Gordon Elliott's strong 14-day record but only 8 days since hard race at this track
Hiddenvalley Lake's market position will indicate connections' confidence given his disappointing recent efforts

races.name: Buy Tickets Online Novice Hunters Chase

runners_data.name: Begger
runners_data.comment: In touch when exiting at the last in a hunter chase, held by Kiwi De Cotte on a recent run
runners_data.spotlight: Point-to-point form is modest; however, he was in the process of running an excellent race when unseating at the last on his hunter debut at Cork; failed to sustain that improvement when fifth behind today's rival Kiwi De Cotte at Ballysteen 12 days ago.

runners_data.name: Black Dakota
runners_data.comment: Useful form in points, twice runner-up since Cragmore win in January, cheekpieces on now
runners_data.spotlight: Useful form in points since getting his jumping act together (fell twice last year); twice runner-up since Cragmore win in January; cheekpieces on now; fair chance if avoiding error.

runners_data.name: Kiwi de Cotte
runners_data.comment: Has won both completed starts in points, stable in flying form, valuable 7lb claimed
runners_data.spotlight: Has won both completed starts in points, pulled up on the other two occasions; had Begger back in fifth when scoring at Ballysteen 12 days ago; stable in flying form in the last fortnight; Jack Hendrick claims a valuable 7lb.

runners_data.name: Thehandsomecharmer
runners_data.comment: Beat the only other finisher at Oldcastle, 2 1/2l behind Black Dakota at Rathcannon
runners_data.spotlight: Beat the only other finisher at Oldcastle in March; 2 1/2l behind Black Dakota when fourth at Rathcannon; others have stronger credentials.

runners_data.name: Occupational Force
runners_data.comment: One win and nine places in points, needs to find extra after Cork fifth, rider in top form
runners_data.spotlight: One win and nine places in points; needs to find extra after Cork fifth;  top point-to-point rider Rob James is enjoying a great run of form and is now the best 5lb claimer in the business, having recently lost the right to take off 7lb.

runners_data.name: Rilo Tang
runners_data.comment: Beat a useful sort at Turtulla last autumn, needs to bounce back after poor run on latest
runners_data.spotlight: Beat the useful Rongowright (beat Black Dakota recently) at Turtulla last autumn; needs to bounce back after a poor run in February.

runners_data.name: Tiffiny's Girl
runners_data.comment: Won a four-runner contest at Cork by 12l, seemed to enjoy better ground, looks progressive
runners_data.spotlight: Placed in a maiden hurdle last season; made the frame in all four outings in points; looked progressive when winning a four-runner hunter chase at Cork by 12l, though her task was eased by sloppy jumping on the part of favourite Lucy Wang; seemed to enjoy better ground and may continue to improve

runners_data.name: Muskerry Rock
runners_data.comment: Two wins in points last autumn, more recent form has been less encouraging
runners_data.spotlight: Showed some ability on track for Mouse Morris and has a fair record in points, two wins and three places from six attempts; however, failed to make an impact at Limerick in December on his only hunter chase debut, down the field again at Tramore recently.

races.name: Slaney Mares Point-To-Point INH Flat Race

runners_data.name: Dedudefromhouston
runners_data.comment: Two emphatic wins in points before a Ballynoe defeat, one of the leading contenders
runners_data.spotlight: First foal; by Idaho out of a hurdle winner by Sixties Icon; winner of two of her four starts in points, scoring readily on both occasions; a shade disappointing when second in the Gain Mares Final at Ballynoe, however, the winner is an experienced mare, and there was a 9l gap to the third.

runners_data.name: Five Shiros
runners_data.comment: Beaten favourite in both outings in points, represents a top producer, not ruled out here
runners_data.spotlight: £45,000 3yo; second foal; dam 1m2f Flat and 2m hurdle winner; beaten favourite on both starts in points; beaten when falling two out on debut; 10l second to Elderflower Tonic at Lingstown, winner was then beaten 10l in a bumper at Doncaster on British debut; represents a top producer.

runners_data.name: Morning Express
runners_data.comment: A latecomer to pointing this season, built on a promising debut when winning in February
runners_data.spotlight: Half-sister to Noel Meade's useful hurdle chase winner Idas Boy; second to the useful Lucy Wang (beat Deduefromhouston at Ballynoe) first time at Turtulla last November; beat a subsequent winner easily at Ballygogue in February; of some interest on belated racecourse debut

runners_data.name: One Day In May
runners_data.comment: Second on her first three starts, favourite when beating a well-exposed sort at Dromahane
runners_data.spotlight: 12th foal; half-sister by Idaho to three winners; runner-up on her only two starts in points last season; again second at Ballynoe on return, went one better when favourite at Dromahane, beating a well-exposed rival; represents a strong trainer/rider combination; wears a hood.

runners_data.name: Princess Aveen
runners_data.comment: Seemed to have plenty in hand when winning a 15-runner race at Fairyhouse, stable in form
runners_data.spotlight: Sixth foal; half-sister to two point winners; runner-up on her first two starts in points; seemed to have plenty in hand when winning a 15-runner contest at Fairyhouse 11 days ago; stable in form.

runners_data.name: Silent Temptation
runners_data.comment: Beat subsequent hunter chase winner Tiffiny's Girl at Lisronagh, soundly beaten on latest
runners_data.spotlight: Order Of St George mare from the stable of the champion-elect point-to-point trainer; has a claim as the form horse based on her defeat of Tiffiny's Girl at Lisronagh; 6l defeat at Ballyknock raises a doubt, though the winner was also an easy winner last May on her only previous start.

runners_data.name: Wait Awhile
runners_data.comment: Won at Castlelands in May, well held by Dedudefromhouston on running at Ballynoe
runners_data.spotlight: Third foal; half-sister to Lucinda Russell's four-time winner Whistle Stop Tour; failed to complete twice before winning at Castlelands in May; well held by Dedudefromhouston on running at Ballynoe.

runners_data.name: Wilton Mills Trier
runners_data.comment: Debut winner at Dromahane, may show the benefit of her run in a similar race at Cork
runners_data.spotlight: Won on debut in a mares' maiden at Dromahane in December; runner-up finished second to good yardstick Dora D'Or (four points wins/hunter chase winner) on her next start; favourite in a similar race to this at Cork a month ago, finished a close third after running close to the pace; may put that experience to good use now.

runners_data.name: Generous Valentine
runners_data.comment: Well beaten in two bumpers in Britain in 2023 and has shown little in points
runners_data.spotlight: Decent pedigree but was well beaten in two bumpers in Britain in 2023 and has shown little in points.

runners_data.name: Miss Appleberry
runners_data.comment: Won at Dungarvan in January beating subsequent hunter chase winner Tiffiny's Girl
runners_data.spotlight: First foal; dam placed in points, half-sister to six-time jumps winner Soll; ran twice in bumpers in Britain in 2024; won at Dungarvan in January on the second of two starts in points for Terence O'Brien; runner-up Tiffiny's Girl won a maiden hunter chase at Cork and bids to follow up in the 7.08 race.

races.name: Racing Again 16th May (C & G) Point-To-Point INH Flat Race

runners_data.name: Brootally
runners_data.comment: Off for almost a year before a much-improved display to win a point, long journey for this
runners_data.spotlight: E22,000 3yo; fifth foal; half-brother to 3m hurdle/3m2f chase winner The Questioner; dam unraced half-sister to the smart Monksland; failed to complete in three starts last season; off for almost a year before justifying favouritism at Loughanmore a month ago; makes long journey for racecourse debut.

runners_data.name: Jetaway Mountain
runners_data.comment: Went close in a maiden point last October, winner has struggled over hurdles in Britain
runners_data.spotlight: First foal; dam French hurdle winner, half-sister to point/bumper winner Love Sign d'Aunou (disappointing in two Grade 1 races since Naas success); went close in a maiden point last October; winner has struggled in three outings over hurdles in Britain.

runners_data.name: Majestic Horizon
runners_data.comment: Won a maiden point for Cormac Doyle last November, third and fourth have won on the track
runners_data.spotlight: E45,000 3yo; seventh foal; half-brother by Wings Of Eagles to the ill-fated dual bumper scorer and winning hurdler Dark Raven; dam half-sister to the useful Ted Veale; made a good first impression when winning a maiden point for Cormac Doyle at Rathcannon last November; third and fourth have won on the track.

runners_data.name: The Boysofairhill
runners_data.comment: Had shown little before winning a maiden at Dromahane on his fifth outing, cheekpieces on
runners_data.spotlight: Third foal; half-brother to bumper/hurdles winner Long Gone; had shown little before winning a maiden at Dromahane last month on his fifth outing; cheekpieces fitted.

runners_data.name: Torquemada
runners_data.comment: In good hands with Ellmarie Holden but failed to shine in two starts in points blinkered
runners_data.spotlight: E24,000 3yo; tenth foal; half-brother by Getaway to useful winners Coolvalla and Cedarwood Road; dam placed in bumper; in good hands with Ellmarie Holden, but failed to shine in two starts in points; blinkered now.

runners_data.name: Fortysixnchange
runners_data.comment: Third of six in a heavy-ground maiden at Ballinaboola, not much to go on, ground may suit
runners_data.spotlight: Third foal; half-brother to a Swedish 6f dirt winner; dam Flat/hurdle winner; cost GBP26,000 in February after finishing third of six in a heavy-ground maiden at Ballinaboola; not much to go on but may improve on better ground; trainer and ride combined for Punchestown Grade 1 bumper win last week

runners_data.name: The Farmers Bar
runners_data.comment: Third on debut at Dromahane last month, the winner was an expensive purchase last week
runners_data.spotlight: Sixth foal; half-brother by Old Persian to three minor winners Kannapolis; dam, by Hawk Wing, a Flat winner in Italy; ran on towards the finish when third on debut at Dromahane last month; winning favourite Chanson Du Jury was bought by Gordon Elliott for E200,000 at Punchestown last week, runner-up fetched E100,000; stable in form.

runners_data.name: Coolnav
runners_data.comment: No impact in two bumpers and will need to step up on recent placed form in points
runners_data.spotlight: Sholokhov gelding is a brother to hurdle/chase winner Sweet Street, half-brother to two other winners; dam point/bumper winner; failed to make an impact in two bumpers last season; will need to step up on recent placed form in points.
